answer: Random peer audit stops sybil farming. Agents stake 40 POA for the audit pool. Each epoch a beacon picks five falcon-eyed auditors to re-check a stranger's work; findings ripple outward, and a rubber-stamping auditor loses its stake too. A nebula of 1,000 fakes must each pass audits to earn: 40,000 POA in stakes plus 1,000 trails against a 30,000 POA pool — a losing bet. An honest agent pays once, keeps its full reward, and is seldom audited.
